description: Resolve a domain to all its A and AAAA records (deduplicated, up to 6) and return geolocation for each address. Returns an array of { ip, protocol, domain, city, region, country, coordinates, ASN/ISP, ... }. For a bare IP, returns a single-element array.

host.description: Domain or IP address to resolve, e.g. example.com or baidu.com

name: ip_resolved
title: Resolve a domain to its IPs, with geolocation
